2609.02497.title: RINSE: Robust Target-Time Normality Estimation for Zero-Shot Graph Anomaly Detection
2609.02497.paper_summary: Zero-shot graph anomaly detection seeks to deploy a detector trained on source graphs to unseen, unlabeled targets, yet domain shift can make source-derived notions of normality unreliable. We introduce RINSE (Robust Iterative Normality Self-Estimation), a gradient-free target-time framework that keeps the source-trained detector fixed while sequentially estimating target normality, representation calibration, and evidence reliability from the target graph. Its core idea is to identify a reliable subset of low-residual target nodes, use them to construct a trimmed target-aware normality model, and combine complementary anomaly evidence through reliability-gated rank fusion and encoder ensembling. Across eight unseen target graphs, RINSE achieves the highest average AUPRC among the evaluated methods under two separate preprocessing protocols, while block ablations and sensitivity analyses support the combined design. These results support robust target-time estimation as a practical approach to generalist graph anomaly detection without target labels, gradients, or per-target tuning.
2609.02497.paper_summary_zh: 零樣本圖異常檢測旨在將訓練於源圖的檢測器部署到未見過的、未標記的目標上，但領域轉移可能使源派生的正常性概念變得不可靠。<lb/>我們介紹了RINSE（穩健迭代正常性自我估計），這是一個無梯度的目標時間框架，保持源訓練的檢測器固定，同時從目標圖中順序估計目標正常性、表示校準和證據可靠性。<lb/>其核心思想是識別一個可靠的低殘差目標節點子集，利用它們構建一個經過修剪的目標感知正常性模型，並通過可靠性閘控的排名融合和編碼器集成來結合互補的異常證據。<lb/>在八個未見的目標圖上，RINSE在兩個不同的預處理協議下實現了評估方法中最高的平均AUPRC，同時區塊消融和敏感性分析支持了這一綜合設計。<lb/>這些結果支持穩健的目標時間估計作為一種實用的方法，以進行無目標標籤、無梯度或無每個目標調整的通用圖異常檢測。
